about: Round 62 (must): the obligations member of v2 checks, filters and bulk operations on a stand with access-control.obligations.enabled=true and access-control.obligations.merge.strategy=weak; the cases of the round before, under the other strategy. Each case runs in a tenant of its own and reads the merged export first; a control goes first and last. Every step that decides is followed by both raw reads of the v3 export, policySets and pips.
